settings.title: Fit & fabric
settings.content:
Oversized, boxy fit with dropped shoulders and a thick ribbed collar. Take your normal size for the intended oversized look.

Heavyweight 100% cotton blank. The exact weight and blank are being confirmed with samples and will be listed here before preorders open.

settings.title: Print
settings.content: Screen-printed. Front: one color. Back: multi-color vintage graphic with a worn texture that's part of the design.

settings.title: Care
settings.content: Wash cold, inside out. Hang dry or tumble low. Don't iron the print.
